definitions.explanation: A bag with insulated lining designed to keep food and drinks cool during transport.

examples.japanese: {保冷|ほれい}バッグに{飲|の}み{物|もの}を{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I put drinks in the cooler bag.

examples.japanese: ピクニックに{保冷|ほれい}バッグを{持|も}っていく。
examples.english: I'll bring a cooler bag to the picnic.

examples.japanese: {夏場|なつば}の{買|か}い{物|もの}では、{生鮮食品|せいせんしょくひん}を{傷|いた}めないように{保冷|ほれい}バッグと{保冷剤|ほれいざい}を{持参|じさん}している。
examples.english: When shopping in summer, I bring a cooler bag and ice packs to keep fresh foods from spoiling.

notes:
A compound of {保冷|ほれい} (keeping cool, cold storage) and バッグ (bag). A practical everyday item in Japan, especially popular during the hot summer months for grocery shopping and outdoor activities.

Many Japanese supermarkets sell or provide {保冷|ほれい}バッグ, and eco-conscious shoppers often bring their own reusable ones. They are also essential for {弁当|べんとう} transport in warm weather.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保冷|ほれい}バッグに{入|い}れる: to put in a cooler bag
- {折|お}りたたみ{保冷|ほれい}バッグ: foldable cooler bag
- {大容量|だいようりょう}{保冷|ほれい}バッグ: large-capacity cooler bag
- {保冷|ほれい}バッグと{保冷剤|ほれいざい}: cooler bag and ice packs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- クーラーボックス: cooler box — a rigid, larger container for keeping items cold
- {保冷剤|ほれいざい}: ice pack, cold pack — the gel packs placed inside cooler bags
- エコバッグ: eco bag, reusable shopping bag — a regular shopping bag without insulation
